nodes.name: CommonQueries.sql
nodes.summary: General-purpose ad-hoc query notebook covering thread management, customer/delivery inspection, cust_rest_map cleanup, OwnTracks queue reads, and miscellaneous order status updates across multiple restaurants (SFCS, ELAS, WREN).

nodes.name: adhoc_queries.sql
nodes.summary: Small collection of one-off investigative queries for inspecting delivery_summary, delivery_option, and food_order records during debugging sessions.

nodes.name: clear_wren_test.sql
nodes.summary: Empty placeholder SQL file, likely reserved for WREN restaurant test-data cleanup scripts.

nodes.name: config_updates.sql
nodes.summary: Operational runbook of ordelo_config UPDATE/INSERT statements for switching between production and test app URLs, dispatch batch sizes, overwatch notification lists, WABA webhook, and per-restaurant timeout settings.

nodes.name: consume_queue.sql
nodes.summary: Development queries for reading and inspecting the pgmq OwnTracks message queue, extracting location and transition events, and joining them against delivery_inflight to correlate riders with active orders.

nodes.name: elas
nodes.summary: Schema definition for the elas thread-tracking table storing WhatsApp thread state including recipient, active flag, and access timestamps.

nodes.name: creating_new_schema.sql
nodes.summary: Schema creation script defining the elas thread-management table with thread_id, recipient, active status, and timestamp columns.

nodes.name: delivery_payouts.sql
nodes.summary: Rider payout calculation queries joining delivery_dispatch, rider_master, rider_registrations, and delivery_option to produce per-order and aggregated payout reports with bank details for a given date range.

nodes.name: distance_travelled.sql
nodes.summary: PostGIS-based CTE query that calculates the distance travelled by riders within a 3-minute rolling window using ST_Distance on rider_location coordinates, filtering out stationary points.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses PostGIS ST_Distance with SRID 4326 geography type; result converted from metres to miles via /1609.34.

nodes.name: elai_updates.sql
nodes.summary: Targeted one-off UPDATE statements for correcting the Elai restaurant record in restaurant_master and related ordelo_config entries.

nodes.name: elas_menu_updates.sql
nodes.summary: Bulk INSERT/UPDATE statements for managing menu items and categories in the ELAS (Elai Salisbury) restaurant, including price corrections and item additions.

nodes.name: master_data_update.sql
nodes.summary: Consolidated maintenance script for restaurant_master, rider_master, and customer_master tables, covering location coordinate corrections, admin array updates, rider shift resets, and INSERT of new restaurant records.

nodes.name: non_prod_init.sql
nodes.summary: Non-production environment initialisation script that seeds ordelo_config with test app URLs and minimal reference data to bootstrap a dev environment.

nodes.name: overwatch_dashboard.sql
nodes.summary: Defines the overwatch_view PostgreSQL function that joins delivery_summary, delivery_dispatch, delivery_option, customer_master, rider_master, and food_order into a single comprehensive monitoring view covering order status, financials, rider info, and customer address.
nodes.languageNotes: Implemented as a CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION returning TABLE, using CTEs to compose data from 6+ tables.

nodes.name: overwatch_views.sql
nodes.summary: Prototype exploration queries and combined CTE view for overwatch monitoring, showing the data joins across delivery_summary, delivery_dispatch, delivery_option, and rider/customer master tables that were used to design the overwatch_view function.

nodes.name: rest_master_updates.sql
nodes.summary: Ad-hoc UPDATE/ALTER statements for restaurant_master covering admin phone arrays, service hours JSON, collection_commission column addition, and test-environment overrides for ELAS, SFCS, WREN, and INDI restaurants.

nodes.name: result_export.json
nodes.summary: Exported snapshot of ordelo_config rows for the SFCS restaurant, capturing timeout values, default pickup times, and app URLs at a specific point in time — used as a reference or seed file.

nodes.name: rider_master_updates.sql
nodes.summary: Maintenance queries for rider_master including SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE of rider profiles (shift status, vehicle type, town), and inspection of rider_registrations data.

nodes.name: settingup_QUEUE.SQL
nodes.summary: PGMQ queue inspection and rider-accept dispatch assignment logic — reads the rider_accept_q queue, applies RANK-based deduplication, and performs the delivery_detail/dispatch/inflight CTE update chain to assign the first valid rider to an order.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses pgmq.read() function and a multi-step CTE with UPDATE and INSERT in sequence to atomically assign a rider.

nodes.name: simulate_dispatches.sql
nodes.summary: Minimal script to trigger the dispatch creation stored procedure for testing the delivery dispatch pipeline manually.

nodes.name: temp.json
nodes.summary: Empty temporary JSON file used as a scratch pad during query development; contains no data.
